subject: 4444J99
purpose: Additional measured axes, released-work totals, accepted-work outcomes, and recorded research-corpus scale; not alternative wording of one push-count statistic.

queries.target:
SELECT countIf(event_type='PushEvent') AS pushes,
uniqExactIf(toDate(created_at),event_type='PushEvent') AS active_push_days,
uniqExactIf(repo_name,event_type='PushEvent') AS repository_names,
uniqExactIf(tuple(repo_name,number),event_type='PullRequestEvent' AND action='opened') AS opened_prs,
countIf(event_type='PullRequestReviewEvent') AS review_events
FROM github_events WHERE lowerUTF8(actor_login)='4444j99'
AND created_at>='2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at<'2026-07-01 00:00:00' FORMAT JSON
queries.push_cohorts:
SELECT count() AS active_accounts,countIf(active_days>155) AS days_above,
countIf(active_days=155) AS days_tied,quantileExact(0.99)(active_days) AS p99_days,
countIf(repo_names>345) AS breadth_above,countIf(repo_names=345) AS breadth_tied,
quantileExact(0.99)(repo_names) AS p99_breadth
FROM (SELECT lowerUTF8(actor_login) AS login,uniqExact(toDate(created_at)) AS active_days,
uniqExact(repo_name) AS repo_names FROM github_events
WHERE event_type='PushEvent' AND actor_login!=''
AND created_at>='2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at<'2026-07-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY login) FORMAT JSON
queries.pr_cohort:
SELECT count() AS pr_openers,countIf(prs>70) AS above,countIf(prs=70) AS tied,
quantileExact(0.99)(prs) AS p99_prs
FROM (SELECT lowerUTF8(actor_login) AS login,uniqExact(tuple(repo_name,number)) AS prs
FROM github_events WHERE event_type='PullRequestEvent' AND action='opened' AND actor_login!=''
AND created_at>='2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at<'2026-07-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY login) FORMAT JSON

derivations.metric: distinct UTC days with public pushes
observed public PRs opened (repository-name + PR number dedup)

archive.formula: Upper-tail share = 100*(accounts_above+accounts_tied)/eligible_accounts; round upward to 0.001 percentage points. Rank = accounts_above+1.
limits: Observed public dataset, not complete GitHub public/private history or a unique-human census; automated accounts included.
Different activity metrics are correlated. Do not multiply percentiles or call their combination an independent rarity probability.
Push counts are source rows; active days are distinct UTC dates, not hours worked; repository breadth uses historical name strings, not stable repository IDs or owned products.
PRs are deduplicated by repository name and number. Renames/transfers can change this identity; openings do not establish merging or code quality.
The 70 observed PRs and 155 push-active days are within this archive window; they do not replace later contribution-calendar totals.
Mutable source; aggregate responses and exact replay queries are preserved, not a full immutable archive or audit of every hourly file.
Manual transcription of each displayed track duration; sums reflect displayed second precision, not audio sample lengths.
Catalog entries include an 8-track remix collection. 63 is not a claim of 63 original compositions or commercially commissioned remixes.
Artist-published release dates, not independent historical timestamp attestations, audience-size or acclaim metrics.
Identity ETCETER4=Anthony is user-provided and linked from his public GitHub profile.
